chunks: If a man leaves a full brother from the same father and mother, then the entire estate belongs to him. Likewise, if there are two full brothers or more than that, the estate is divided equally among them. If he leaves a full sister, then she has one-half by explicit designation, and the remainder is returned to her because she is the nearest of kin and one possessing an assigned share. Likewise, if he leaves two full sisters or more, they have two-thirds by explicit designation, and the remainder is returned to them by the share of the kindred. If they are full brothers and sisters, then the estate is divided among them, with the male receiving the portion of two females. Likewise, paternal brothers and sisters take the place of full brothers and sisters in every case when there are no full brothers and sisters. So if he leaves a full brother and a paternal brother, the entire estate belongs to the full brother from the father and mother, and the paternal brother is excluded. Paternal siblings, male or female, inherit nothing alongside full siblings, male or female. So if he leaves a full brother and a paternal sister, the entire estate belongs to the full brother from the father and mother. Likewise, if he leaves a full sister and a paternal brother, the entire estate belongs to the full sister from the father and mother: she has one-half by explicit designation, and what remains belongs to the nearest of kin, and she is the nearest of kin.

key_terms.أَقْرَبُ أُولِي الْأَرْحَامِ: The nearest among the blood relatives.
key_terms.الثُّلُثَانِ بِالتَّسْمِيَةِ: Two-thirds assigned as a designated fixed share in inheritance.
key_terms.النِّصْفُ بِالتَّسْمِيَةِ: One-half assigned as a designated fixed share in inheritance.
key_terms.ذَاتُ سَهْمٍ: An heir who possesses a fixed designated share.
key_terms.ذَوِي الْأَرْحَامِ: Blood relatives or kindred entitled through kinship.
key_terms.رَدٌّ عَلَيْهَا: The remainder of the estate is returned to the same heir after fixed shares.
key_terms.سَقَطَ الْأَخُ مِنَ الْأَبِ: The paternal brother is excluded from inheritance.
key_terms.لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ: The inheritance principle that a male receives the share of two females.

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided among full brothers, full sisters, and paternal siblings in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This text sets out inheritance rulings for full siblings and paternal siblings. It explains the fixed shares of full sisters, the equal division among full brothers, the rule that a male receives the share of two females when brothers and sisters inherit together, and that paternal siblings are excluded by full siblings.
